'''Tufar''' was the sixth planet in the [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] system. It was a frigid world of [[Methane/Legends|methane]] ice.

==History==
Tufar originally possessed a small listening station that was established when the system was first settled. However, the life support failed when a small meteor breached the airtight prefabricated structure, killing all six workers manning the station.
